neighbours.mechanism_note: Similar symptoms, different cause. Niemann-Pick disease type C: lysosomal storage (degradation inside the lysosome fails) (via MONDO:0002561 lysosomal storage disease). Pelizaeus-Merzbacher spectrum disorder: primary hypomyelination (myelin is never properly formed; PLP1 / PMD spectrum, POLR3) (via MONDO:0010714 Pelizaeus-Merzbacher spectrum disorder). No shared causal gene; phenotype similarity simGIC 0.24. Assets and trial designs do not transfer between them without expert review. Reactome: no pathway annotated for PLP1, so pathway overlap 0 is a data gap, not evidence of a different mechanism.
